items.text: "This is a very needed project to deal with our beach erosion and the protection of our wastewater treatment plant. Ocean Shores appreciates the work Kilmer & former Mayor Dingler put into securing the funding needed to get this project started" - Ocean Shores Mayor Jon Martin

As a parent, I know how important it is to ensure your kids have the nutrition they need. The current infant formula shortage is unacceptable. That’s why I’m voting for legislation to get the FDA the resources it needs to address this shortage and prevent it from happening again. https://t.co/YH8STXleqq

This expansion will also increase addiction recovery services, and day-use space to provide critical wellness services such as workforce development, mental health and substance use counseling. It was great to stop by and meet with the team to learn more about the expansion plan! https://t.co/vb8o8gW0a7

Today I voted to support the #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act - a bipartisan legislative package to strengthen more than 30 programs that support mental health care and substance use disorder prevention, care, treatment, and recovery support services. https://t.co/6zq6zZc7hE
Wishing @POTUS a full and speedy recovery! https://t.co/DgN4KeAk1u

We also discussed the need to increase capacity for mental health and substance abuse treatment and how we can continue to work together to keep our communities safe. Thank you for this opportunity - and count me as a partner! https://t.co/P6M1WOXysV

In addition to connecting with health care providers and hospital leadership, I was thrilled to learn more about the effort to secure federal funding to establish a cancer treatment facility for patients undergoing radiation therapy in Jefferson County. I'll keep pushing! https://t.co/laYG9tPQGO

Last week I participated in a joint training exercise with Central Kitsap Fire & Rescue, South Kitsap Fire & Rescue, North Kitsap Fire & Rescue, Bainbridge Fire Department, Poulsbo Fire Department, & Bremerton Fire Department. It was awesome to see the entire crew in action! https://t.co/iTCv8dFB7W

Then I downed a blackberry caramel apple from Amy’s Decadent Chocolate (also made in Bremerton). Happy to visit with some local small businesses (but going back on the diet today)! https://t.co/aGdZFMd439

Head Start is the most successful, longest-running, national school readiness program - providing comprehensive education, health, nutrition, & parent involvement services to low-income kids & their families. Great to visit @tacomaschools Head Start Center at Franklin Elementary! https://t.co/ryzV02FxwR

Last week, I joined social service providers in Clallam County for a roundtable discussion. Together, we discussed access to behavioral healthcare, affordable housing, substance abuse treatment, and how to eliminate hunger in our communities. https://t.co/9kVhgAmOMx

Every few years Congress passes a "Farm Bill" - which helps set national agriculture, nutrition, and forestry policy. It was great to sit down w/ local farmers & food advocates in Poulsbo to talk about priorities for our region. I'll keep pushing to get them included in the bill! https://t.co/xfedM033jt

Our seniors need access to reliable, healthy meals.

Cutting federal spending back to the 2022 level would mean nutrition services, like @_MealsOnWheels, would be cut for more than one million seniors. https://t.co/lHPHQc1wlG
Civilians aren't expected to travel more than an hour to receive treatment – that we ask those in uniform to do so is wrong. https://t.co/WY5cBmDbbd

Last week, @EPA pledged a game-changing $12 million to @UW, championing environmental justice in our region.

This vital funding will help ensure fair treatment and meaningful involvement for all, shaping a greener future through inclusive environmental policy.

Every American has been touched in a personal way by cancer – whether it’s as a survivor or seeing it impact a family member or friend.

Great to catch up with my friend, Dr. Hans-Peter Kiem from @fredhutch, to discuss emerging cell and gene therapies for the treatment of cancer. https://t.co/US0XRHAwSL

This isn’t about partisanship – these cuts would have a devastating effect on Washingtonians.

❌ 164,500 veterans could lose medical care
❌ 4,800 preschool and child care slots would be eliminated
❌ 371,000 Washingtonians could lose Medicaid coverage https://t.co/WjORoglPpX

Happy National Nurses Week!

Thank you to all the dedicated and compassionate nurses on the front lines of health care, providing exceptional care to patients and families – you’re true heroes! https://t.co/DbHI6iGWQd

I'm with Dunia – a patient in a rural community on the Olympic Peninsula should have the same shot at the best chemotherapy as a patient in the shadow of the Space Needle.

That's why I'm working in D.C. to address a national shortage of cancer drugs. https://t.co/QVY4YgOnLn

Rural hospitals are vital lifelines in our communities, ensuring that every American, no matter where they live, has access to quality care when they need it.

That's why I'm working on bipartisan legislation to help rural hospitals keep the lights on. https://t.co/l0Sl7DGPpu

The Colorado anti-discrimination law was created to stop unfair treatment and focuses on regulating actions, not what people say.

When we reduce this issue to just free speech, we undermine the inclusive values we strive for as a nation.

No matter who you are or where you’re from, you ought to be able to find quality health care close to home.

It’s time for Congress to step up and ensure folks in rural America can get medical help without traveling far from home and without going broke. https://t.co/8wmnuZGrCK

This announcement is a testament to the power of investment in rural communities.

With federal funding focused on helping communities care for people, we’re enhancing emergency response capabilities and access to healthy food on the Olympic Peninsula. https://t.co/amZGh8mWK1

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, Washingtonians have more money to put food on the table and provide for their families.

This year, an estimated 21,000 folks in our region have already enrolled in ACA marketplace health insurance coverage, saving $1,150 on average. https://t.co/HjjMEyWyT0

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, @CMSGov announced the first ten drugs selected for Medicare Price Negotiation earlier this morning.

Soon, the IRA will finally allow Medicare to negotiate lower prescription drug costs for folks in Washington state. https://t.co/h3FLvPYkgX
